description:
OEDRO's Roll-Up Truck Bed Covers provide the perfect combination of safety, convenience, and looks for your pickup truck. With the tailgate latch system and hook-and-loop tape that seals on both sides, your truck bed instantly becomes a trunk that's 100% protected from snow, rain, UV rays, and dust.
Features
Protect your truck bed. OEDRO's roll-up soft truck bed cover provides your pickup truck with the perfect combination of safety, convenience, and appearance. With the help of the tailgate latch system and the velcro strips sealed on both sides, your truck bed instantly becomes a 100% snow, rain, UV, and dust-resistant luggage compartment.
Heavy-duty PVC material. OEDRO's truck tonneau cover is made of double-layer PVC, which has been thoroughly tested to provide UV protection and excellent tensile properties. Includes pre-assembled powder-coated rails and aluminum clips for trouble-free installation and strong stability.
No need to drill. No drill clamps to fix the trunk lid rails to the floor of your truck. The installation can be completed within 20-30 minutes using a wrench and socket.
Aerodynamic profile. The tonneau cover is installed on top of your bed railing to provide maximum cargo space and waterproof performance.
1-Year Warranty | Professional installation recommended for safety.
Fitment
Compatible with 2002-2018 Dodge Ram 1500 | Fleetside 8' Bed without Rambox.
Compatible with 2003-2025 Dodge Ram 2500 3500 | Fleetside 8' Bed without Rambox.
Compatible with 2019-2023 Ram 1500 Classic Fleetside 8' Bed without Rambox.
For models without the Cargo Management Utility Track System.
Without Rambox and Split Tailgate| Sealed on both sides with hook and loop tape, the top is secured with a tailgate latch lock system that keeps the cover wrinkle-free and tight.
